anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Before the abrupt transition, reflux was 0.261 L/h and distillate flow was 0.376 L/h.
Reflux collapsed to 0.016 L/h while distillate flow fell to 0.229 L/h.
Reflux remained near zero at 0.012 L/h while distillate flow rose to 0.654 L/h, indicating sustained disruption of reflux and withdrawal.
System pressure was 500.153 mbar and differential pressure was 1.868 mbar.
System pressure rose to 509.27 mbar and differential pressure increased to 3.334 mbar.

System pressure rose further to 521.672 mbar; differential pressure was 2.670 mbar. T701 fell to 416.844 °C from 428.886 °C at 1080 s; its unusually high absolute reading also requires independent validation.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol setpoints and commanded changes are needed to rule out an intended transition; verify reflux delivery and valve state, independently confirm pressure and reboiler temperature, and inspect vacuum/exhaust performance to distinguish causes. No composition measurement or target specification is available to assess separation.
